proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9369 bhaṇṭākī gives Bi. bhaṇṭā, B. bhā̃ṭā and Sinhala baṭu eggplant. The survey baṭa/bhaṭaa forms fit that first branch, retaining source nasalization or its absence. Reviewed comparison: Buksa bʰʌʈa “eggplant” (f_ee7enze5sklje). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5958 taila explicitly gives Kalasha teu and regional tel/tilla oil. These teo/tyal/tiḷ responses fit the oil noun; source meanings distinguish it from tila sesame. Reviewed comparison: Bshk tāl “oil” (f_xpn6t4jtqpkeu). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.
